claim: For every finite nonempty complete multipartite graph G, let m_s be the number of parts of size s. Then its ordinary first-order logical width is W(G)=1+max(max{s:m_s>0}, max{m_s:m_s>0}).
integrity: The upper bound is an explicit variable-recycling definition by exact class size and multiplicity. The lower bound supplies a nonisomorphic witness and an all-round pebble-game strategy in each of the two extremal regimes. Finite profile and game computations corroborate the reductions but are not used as the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty simple complete multipartite graphs in ordinary first-order logic only; no counting quantifiers, formula-length claim, quantifier-rank claim, or infinite-structure extension. Priority risk from folklore or unindexed exercises remains.
title: Exact logical width of arbitrary complete multipartite graphs
